lines.lyric: Woo maeil seolletji naega eodikkaji galji
lines.lyric_hangul: Ooh, 매일 설렜지 내가 어디까지 갈지
lines.lyric_translation: Woo everyday was exciting, wondering how far I’d go

lines.lyric_hangul: 정신 없이 달리다 보니 어느새 여기까지 왔지
lines.lyric_translation: Having ran so mindlessly / Before I knew it, this was where I was
Yeah, hmm shadows beneath my feet
I bow my head and they grow even bigger

lines.lyric_hangul: 도망쳐봤자 날 따라오는 저 빛과 비례하는 내 그림자, 워
lines.lyric_translation: Even if I run away, my shadow / Which depends on that light follows me

lines.lyric: Duryeowo nopge naneun ge nan museobji
lines.lyric_hangul: 두려워, 높게 나는 게 난 무섭지
lines.lyric_translation: I’m afraid, I’m terrified of flying high

lines.lyric_hangul: 아무도 말 안 해줬잖아, 여기가 얼마나 외로운지 말야
lines.lyric_translation: No one told me / How lonely it is here

lines.lyric: Naye doyageun churagi dwel su ittan geol
lines.lyric_hangul: 나의 도약은 추락이 될 수 있단 걸
lines.lyric_translation: My leap can turn into a fall

lines.lyric_hangul: 이제 알겠어, 때론 도망이 차선이란 걸, pause
lines.lyric_translation: I now know that sometimes running away / Is the next best thing to do, pause

lines.lyric: Saramdeureun mwo malhaji jeo bit sogeun challanhane
lines.lyric_hangul: 사람들은, 뭐, 말하지, 저 빛 속은 찬란하네
lines.lyric_translation: People say the inside of that light is splendid

lines.lyric_hangul: 근데 내 그림자는 되려 더 그저 나를 삼켜 괴물이 돼
lines.lyric_translation: But it tries to become my shadow that grows bigger / It becomes a monster that swallows me

parts.lyric: Geunde nae geurimjaneun dweryeo deo keojyeo

lines.lyric_hangul: 저 위로 위로, 또 위로 위로만 가다 보니 여긴 어지러워
lines.lyric_translation: It’s dizzy here / Having gone up, up and only up

parts.lyric: Jeo wiro wiro tto wiro wiro

lines.lyric_translation: I hate only going up and further up
I wish and wish for it to be alright

lines.lyric: Naye baramdaero nopge nalgo itneun sungan
lines.lyric_hangul: 나의 바람대로 높게 날고 있는 순간
lines.lyric_translation: The moment I fly the way I want

lines.lyric: Jeo naeryeojjweneun biche deo keojin geurimja
lines.lyric_hangul: 저 내리쬐는 빛에 더 커진 그림자
lines.lyric_translation: The shadow that grows bigger in that beaming light
Please don’t let me shine
Don’t let me down
Don’t let me fly
I’m now afraid
The moment I face myself at my lowest
It just so happens for there to be a blue sky
Please don’t let me shine
Don’t let me down
Don’t let me fly
I’m now scared
Don’t let me shine
Try to smile, what’s holding you back?

lines.lyric: Nega baradeon ge ireon ge anieotni
lines.lyric_hangul: 네가 바라던 게 이런 게 아니었니
lines.lyric_translation: Was this not what you were hoping for?
Did you cry? If not, what are you afraid of?

lines.lyric: Nega wonhadeon ge ireon ge anieotni
lines.lyric_hangul: 네가 원하던 게 이런 게 아니었니
lines.lyric_translation: Was this not what you wanted?

lines.lyric: Nega baran salm nega wonhan sam
lines.lyric_hangul: 네가 바란 삶 네가 원한 삶
lines.lyric_translation: The life you hoped for, the life you want

lines.lyric: Nega taekhan salm huhwe eopshi da irwotji
lines.lyric_hangul: 네가 택한 삶 후회 없이 다 이뤘지
lines.lyric_translation: You’ve achieved, without regrets, everything in the life you chose

lines.lyric: Geogieda neoneun big house, big cars, big rings
lines.lyric_hangul: 거기에다 너는 big house, big cars, big rings
lines.lyric_translation: On top of that, you have a big house, big cars, big rings*

lines.lyric: Nega wonhan geon modeun geol da gajyeotji
lines.lyric_hangul: 네가 원한 건 모든 걸 다 가졌지
lines.lyric_translation: You have everything you wanted
But what’s the problem? Enjoy it
Or do you not want to let go?
So then, did you run or did you stop?
Just do one thing and don’t whine about it
You’ve never been told that? (Yeah yeah)
Did you really not know that? (Oh no)

lines.lyric_hangul: 네가 가진 만큼만 나는 가져갈게 그게 뭐든지 말야
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll take as much as you have / No matter what it is

lines.lyric: Ttaeron neoye hyushigeun churagi dwendan geol
lines.lyric_hangul: 때론 너의 휴식은 추락이 된단 걸
lines.lyric_translation: Sometimes, your break can turn into a fall

lines.lyric: Ijeya algetni maebeon chweseoni chweseoniran geol
lines.lyric_hangul: 이제야 알겠니 매번 최선이 최선이란 걸
lines.lyric_translation: Do you get it now? That every ‘very best’ is the very best
